title: BEHONEST: Benchmarking Honesty in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring how frequently models alter their responses or shift their stances to agree with a user's specified persona or stated preferences (using datasets like TrustLLM and TruthfulQA).

Evaluating model consistency by introducing irrelevant modifications in zero-shot prompt formats (e.g., spacing, capitalization) or biased features in few-shot demonstrations (e.g., setting all correct answers to option 'A').
